scripts.dev: pnpm run css:build && concurrently -k -n css,server "pnpm run css:watch" "NODE_ENV=development node --watch --import remix/node-tsx server.ts"
scripts.hmr: pnpm run css:build && concurrently -k -n css,hmr "pnpm run css:watch" "NODE_ENV=development node hmr.ts"
scripts.start: pnpm run css:build && NODE_ENV=production node --import remix/node-tsx server.ts
